correctness.rationale: The explicit 32-vertex LCF graph is cubic with 48 edges; the standard unordered deleted-product model has cells C0,C1,C2 of sizes 496,1440,1032. Independent boundary construction verifies ∂1∂2=0 and rank_F101 ∂2=928, bounding the integral H2 rank by 104. Enumerating all simple 6/8 cycles yields 16/12 and disjoint pairs 72/96/18. Each of 186 signed cycle-product chains has zero boundary. An independent 104-row projection of these cycles has exact integer Hermite normal form I104, showing surjectivity to Z^104 and, with rank bound, integral identification ker∂2≅Z104. For 6/6 columns the Smith diagonal is 72 ones; including 6/8 gives 102 ones and two twos. Aut(Dyck) enumerates as 192 elements with pair orbits 24,48,96,6,12; independent HNF checks show each 8/8 orbit separately kills the residual (Z/2)^2. The minimal two extra generators follows from its two-dimensional mod-two quotient, not from numerics.

value.rationale: The Dyck graph has two geometrically canonical regular-map embeddings, with face cycles of lengths six and eight. Exact integral generation shows an obstruction invisible in rational H2 and tied to these two embeddings; the two-element minimal completion and automorphism-orbit classification give a natural fully determined finite invariant.

final_claim: For UConf_2 of the Dyck graph, H2≅Z^104; 72 disjoint 6/6 cycle tori span a rank-72 primitive lattice, adding 96 6/8 tori leaves quotient (Z/2)^2, and adjoining 18 8/8 tori generates integrally. Either of the two octagon-pair symmetry orbits alone completes the lattice.
